title: Startup Advisory — Day 5: Startup Tax Holiday, Loss Carry-Forward & ESOP Deferral
takeaway: DPIIT recognition alone does not grant tax holidays or ESOP tax deferral; Inter-Ministerial Board (IMB) approval is mandatory under Income-tax provisions.
